_doc: Brief Intake Schema v3 — guided subfields. Organizing principle: a design job is fully determined by FOUR buckets (artifact / use-context / content / tone+brand). The SCHEMA (buckets+fields) is STABLE; the VOCABULARY (enum options) is OPEN ('other' absorbs novelty). This stops the 'miss-and-add-every-test' churn: every brief-fact has exactly one home. Derived from Step-0 falsification (2026-06-11): VLM discriminates register on PLAYFULNESS+FORMALITY (energy is a decoy, dropped; grab is the TARGET not an input).
_form_behavior: ADAPTIVE (decided 2026-06-11): the full schema is always complete, but the rendered form shows only fields relevant to the chosen asset_type. asset_type is the FIRST question; it gates which bucket-B/D fields appear (手举牌 surfaces usage_context+logo_treatment+vibe; business_card hides them). Resolves the encompassing-vs-friction tension: completeness without the 16-field wall. Each field also carries a smart default so a fast user can accept-all.

_provenance_types.human_set: user populates in the form (cheap facts, no design vocab needed)
_provenance_types.inferred: system derives from human facts (e.g. register from use-context+vibe+logo)
_provenance_types.brand_derived: from answer_key (actual hex, licensed font files)
_provenance_types.reference_derived: flex/hold map from (reference - brand DNA), when a reference exists

bucket_A_artifact._desc: What is physically/digitally being made. Drives size, orientation, register DEFAULTS.

asset_type._note: asset_type carries a DEFAULT use-context + register, overridable by bucket B

bucket_B_use_context._desc: ⭐ THE BUCKET WE STRUCTURALLY MISSED. How/where/by-whom the asset is encountered. THIS is the register-bearing bucket — it carries 灵动/亮眼/grabbable that 'asset_type=手举牌' alone never conveyed.

usage_context._note: the single highest-leverage register signal. 'held for photos' => event_prop

bucket_C_content._desc: What the asset must contain or say.

mandatory_elements._note: dates, legal text, 分别画叉, QR, specific icons/objects (e.g. 'wood pedestal'). The must-INCLUDE slot.

subject._note: for product/photo work: what it shows

bucket_D_tone_and_brand._desc: How it should FEEL + how tightly on-brand. Where register is DECLARED (vs inferred from B).

vibe._desc: Multi-axis, NOT single. Step-0 kept the discriminating axes only.
vibe._dropped: ENERGY — Step-0 showed it doesn't discriminate (our corporate signs scored energetic too)

logo_treatment._note: WE MISSED THIS — the lively refs had NO logo. Must be an explicit ask.

brand_strictness._note: the register dial; reconciles with reference-diff when a ref exists

derivation._desc: The form collects human-answerable FACTS; the system makes the designer's LEAP. register = f(usage_context, audience, vibe, logo_treatment, brand_strictness), refined by reference-diff if present.
derivation.calibration_gate: register profile shown to human in plain language for eyeball/correct BEFORE generation (same pattern as approval loop)

reference_input._desc: FIRST-CLASS input, top-level (feeds BOTH channels, not any single bucket). DECISION 2026-06-13 (docs/REFERENCE_AS_VISUAL_CHANNEL_design_note.md): the 定稿 proved a ref ~90% governs the final. Apply the describe->FEED law to STYLE refs, not just logos.

reference_image.ask: Got an image whose look you like (a past piece, the actual product, a mood)? Drop it in. Crop it to ONE panel/example first.
reference_image._note: Human crops to 1 panel (2-sec job, do NOT auto-crop). FED DIRECTLY to gpt-image-2 as a visual style exemplar (the VISUAL channel) AND parsed for register (the SEMANTIC channel). KEEP BOTH — feeding alone failed (太标识类) when the prompt fought the ref; prompt must AGREE with ref.

options: template — extend this series (clone look, change message)
inspiration — vague mood for a NEW campaign (loose direction)
reference_relationship.ask: Is this reference a template to extend, a style to match, or loose inspiration?
reference_relationship._note: Governs HOW MUCH the fed ref controls output — replaces an ungovernable dial. template->high; inspiration->low. ALWAYS bounded by the lock table (ref never overrides hard brand identity: hex/licensed font/compliance) + the crop (layout can't bleed). AIA 定稿 = template type -> ~90% clone was CORRECT.

channels.visual_FED: cropped ref image -> gpt-image-2: carries font, icon style, color, protruding-icon device (what text cannot name)
channels.semantic_PARSED: ref -> register calibration + scene-author: which icon per message, copy, hierarchy, and aligning the PROMPT with the ref
